name: Wind Power RAG Platform
tagline: Real-time turbine monitoring across 8 wind farms
background: Designed and built an enterprise-grade knowledge retrieval platform for wind turbine maintenance. Handling over 2TB of technical documentation with sub-second retrieval times.

technicalDecisions.title: pgvector + BM25 hybrid search
technicalDecisions.explanation: Implemented hybrid search for precise technical jargon retrieval, combining dense vector similarity with keyword matching.

technicalDecisions.title: Cohere Reranker layer
technicalDecisions.explanation: Engineered a reranker to increase Top-5 accuracy from 50% to 90%, improving answer quality for maintenance queries.

technicalDecisions.title: Parent-child chunking strategy
technicalDecisions.explanation: Developed a chunking strategy for complex industrial manuals, preserving context across section boundaries.

technicalDecisions.title: OCR with vision model integration
technicalDecisions.explanation: Integrated OCR with vision models to catalog technical drawing metadata and make visual documentation searchable.

name: Gate.com SEO Special Project
tagline: Performance-first SEO architecture for a top-10 crypto exchange
background: Spearheaded the SEO overhaul for a top 10 global crypto exchange, migrating mission-critical data pages to a robust SSR architecture to dominate search engine rankings.

technicalDecisions.title: CSR to Next.js SSR + ISR migration
technicalDecisions.explanation: Orchestrated migration with 60s revalidation for dynamic financial data, ensuring crawlable HTML for search engines.

technicalDecisions.title: JSON-LD Schema injection
technicalDecisions.explanation: Injected Dataset and FinancialProduct schemas to maximize Google Rich Results across liquidation and funding rate pages.

technicalDecisions.title: Progressive rollout strategy
technicalDecisions.explanation: Implemented rollout starting with high-traffic pages, validating SEO gains before expanding to the full page catalog.

technicalDecisions.title: Layout shift elimination
technicalDecisions.explanation: Eliminated CLS by optimizing font preloading and enforcing image aspect-ratio boxes throughout the page templates.

name: Michaels Mall Design System
tagline: Shared frontend foundation across four retail product lines
quote: LCP optimized from 4s to 1.8s across all core commerce pages.
background: Led the frontend architecture for the US retail giant Michaels, unifying four distinct product lines under a single, performant design system and modern build pipeline.

technicalDecisions.title: Webpack to Vite migration
technicalDecisions.explanation: Executed migration reducing HMR response time from 3s to <0.5s, dramatically improving developer iteration speed.

technicalDecisions.title: Multi-layered Design Token system
technicalDecisions.explanation: Built Global → Semantic → Component token layers supporting multiple brand themes without duplicating component logic.

technicalDecisions.title: Rollup multi-entry builds
technicalDecisions.explanation: Engineered ESM/CJS builds to ensure tree-shaking efficiency for all consuming applications across product lines.

technicalDecisions.title: Zero-overhead library migration
technicalDecisions.explanation: Swapped legacy dependencies for modern alternatives (lodash → lodash-es, moment → day.js) reducing bundle size.

name: Chaos Engineering Platform
tagline: Self-service fault injection platform for Guiyang Bank
background: Designed a mission-critical failure injection platform for Guiyang Bank, translating complex backend resilience testing into an intuitive visual workspace.

technicalDecisions.title: AntV/X6 graph-based experiment designer
technicalDecisions.explanation: Developed a graph designer enabling drag-and-drop fault orchestration, cutting experiment setup time by 60%.

technicalDecisions.title: Canvas-based rendering strategy
technicalDecisions.explanation: Implemented Canvas rendering for real-time monitoring of 2,000+ data points/s, handling high-frequency updates.

technicalDecisions.title: requestAnimationFrame + data windowing
technicalDecisions.explanation: Optimized rendering cycles to maintain a steady 60fps under peak observability load without frame drops.

technicalDecisions.title: Automated PDF report distribution
technicalDecisions.explanation: Built automated PDF export utilizing AntV/G2 chart snapshots, integrating reports directly into experiment results.
